summary: Short kerb at about 16% grade, with flats 12 m away.
reasons: Apartments 12 m away at the top end

best_section.where: North kerb below the shaded driveway, before the bend

drivers.seclusion: Apartments 12 m and 13 m away on the north side; houses 19-22 m on the south side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street with a parallel parking kerb; cars park nearby, and the stretch is short.
drivers.convention: Parallel parking is signed with no limit, and cars use it.

sun_shade: Dense tree canopy shades the kerb, mostly from the north and east.
